facts.doc_title: Fatality - Uncontrolled Descent of a Suspended Component in the Heavy Workshop
facts.site: Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop

response.body: The inspection and periodic proof testing of lifting gear shall be provided and maintained for work covered by this safety alert. This clause applies to activities archived under LIFTING-AND-SUSPENDED-LOADS at Yandarra Downs Open Cut and Heavy Workshop.
